name: Town Board Orders
summary: Your neighbours pin new farm requests to the town board: cheese, preserves, eggs, milk, flowers and wild finds, paid in gold and friendship.
logoPrompt: A small wooden notice board with three blank paper notes pinned to it, a wicker basket of eggs, a wedge of cheese and a jar of jam standing in front of it
description: **Town Board Orders pins six new special orders to the town's Special Orders board, all about the work you already do on your farm.**
- Gus wants cheese for the saloon, Pierre wants jelly or pickles for an empty shelf.
- Shane hopes you ship plenty of eggs, Jodi needs milk for her boys.
- Evelyn asks for flowers for the town square, Leah for foraged goods to paint.
- Each order pays gold and a heart of friendship with the villager who asked, never rare items.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. The board opens in the fall of your first year and shows new orders every Monday.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher.
- An order only shows up once your farm makes what it asks for, and Evelyn skips the winter.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
